front.title: DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) Signatures with SM2 and SM3 Cryptographic Algorithms

author.organization: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

abstract.t:
This document adds the SM2-SM3 signing algorithm to DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM). It defines the signature and public key encodings and the SM2 user identifier used with this algorithm. This document updates RFC 6376.
